# Economy & Inventory Integrity Requirements Quality Checklist: Inventory, Ground Loot & Currency Ledger

**Purpose**: Đánh giá chất lượng, tính đầy đủ, độ rõ ràng và mức độ bảo vệ chống gian lận của các yêu cầu kho đồ, chiến lợi phẩm rơi và sổ cái 5 loại tiền tệ (`005-inventory-loot`).
**Created**: 2026-11-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Inventory Structure & Ownership Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are bag capacity bounds (`40–120` slots), storage capacity bounds (`0–200` slots unlocked via `bld_storage`), and per-character JSON file sharding unambiguously specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK002 Are globally unique `UUIDv7` item instance identifiers, `ownerCharacterId` ownership enforcement, and slot-uniqueness invariants completely defined across both bag and storage containers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all inventory mutations (move, swap, stack/merge, split, sort, bag-storage transfer within `<= 96 px`, quick-use consumable with `5,000 ms` potion cooldown, NPC sell) clearly covered with quantity bounds `[1..maxStack]`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Ground Loot & Anti-Ninja-Loot Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Are `GroundLoot` RAM-only lifecycle rules (`120s` TTL, zero disk I/O while on ground, automatic memory cleanup on expiry) explicitly defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Constitution §IV]
- [ ] CHK005 Are anti-ninja-loot eligibility rules (`PERSONAL_INSTANCED` default vs `ROUND_ROBIN` option), pickup distance validation (`<= 96 px`), and atomic in-memory claim locking (`claimed`) unambiguously specified? [Security, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the full-bag pickup failure behavior clearly specified so unpicked loot remains safely on the ground for its remaining TTL instead of being lost? [Edge Case, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 Are server-authoritative 4-step loot table roll ordering (`goldDrop → guaranteed → independent → exclusivePools`) and the `+25%` `LUK` drop bonus cap consistently aligned with `game-data/loot-tables.json`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Constitution §III]

## Atomic Currency Ledger & Anti-Duplication Integrity

- [ ] CHK008 Are all 5 canonical currencies (`GOLD`, `STARLIGHT_SHARD`, `CRAFTING_TOKEN`, `BOSS_TOKEN`, `STAR_ESSENCE`) and the monthly append-only JSON ledger (`ledgers/currency-ledger-YYYY-MM.json`) explicitly specified without any external DBMS? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK009 Are mathematical ledger invariants (`delta != 0`, `balanceBefore >= 0`, `balanceAfter === balanceBefore + delta >= 0`) and reconciliation consistency between `CurrencyWallet` and `CurrencyLedger` clearly measurable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK010 Are concurrency lock ordering, `24-hour` `idempotencyKey` replay protection, optimistic revision checking, and multi-file JSON WAL commit requirements explicitly mandated for every inventory/currency mutation? [Security, Spec §FR-007, Constitution §II]

## Cross-Feature Boundaries & Verification Honesty

- [ ] CHK011 Are protections against selling/deleting currently equipped items or locked quest items explicitly specified as business edge cases? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Are storage write latency targets (`p95 < 15 ms`) transparently labeled `proposed / unverified` along with the fallback sharding strategy (monthly → daily ledger) if contention exceeds thresholds? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004, Spec §Assumptions, Constitution §VIII]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after human/lead review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
